messages:
deploy-bot: Deploy blocked — SBOM provenance verification failed for image redwood/service-api:sha256:fa3b7d...
Reason: missing signature certificate chain. Canaries halted.

alex: pinging QA and security. Is this a missing signature or a builder key mismatch?

maya: reproduced on staging canary 2/3. SBOM shows origin 'ci-builder-3' not 'ci-builder-1' — suspicious.

sam: that's the new multi-builder pipeline; we didn't update the provenance stamping step in that job.

tony-security: likely benign if builder key rotated, but KMS-verified keys don't match. No quick skip without approval.

rachel: release is in change window until 14:00 PT, need decision fast — release notes are ready.

alex: options: 1) pin to previous digest (sha256:9c8f2...) and continue canary; 2) timebox 2h for signature fix and continue; 3) rollback full release and delay.

maya: pinning lowers test coverage for the bugfix in this release (we reintroduce old behavior). QA: can run a targeted regression on the pinned canary.

sam: can do pin for canary only if deploy-bot supports partial-pin. @deploy-bot, can we pin canary-only?

deploy-bot: yes — command: `rb deploy --image redwood/service-api@sha256:9c8f2... --target=canary-eu`

alex: vulnerability scan was green earlier, right?

tony-security: vuln scan = green. This is a provenance/signature compliance issue. Legal signoff needed for any prod exception. @legal-bot can legal triage within 2h?

legal-bot: opened legal ticket #452 and assigned to @nora. ETA ~90m for initial review.

nora: I see the artifact. I need cosign provenance and builder attestation to approve exception. Can eng provide those within the window?

sam: I'm on it — will collect cosign attestation and builder logs now and upload to the legal ticket.

maya: QA can run a smoke + regression on pinned canary in ~20m.

alex: temporary decision: pin canary to previous digest in EU/APAC to keep limited rollout, timebox 120 minutes for eng to produce attestation + legal review. If attestation fails, rollback globally.

rachel: updating release notes: adding a "pinned canary" note and change-window comment.

tony-security: will add monitoring alert and a dashboard card for provenance anomalies.

sam: starting attestation gather: `./scripts/collect-attestations --image redwood/service-api:sha256:fa3b7d... > /tmp/attest.json` then uploading to internal storage.

maya: QA queued smoke tests against pinned canary now.

deploy-bot: Canary pin applied to EU cluster. Canary health: healthy ✅

alex: thanks — created follow-up runbook ticket #871 to track: eng/qa/security/legal owners, timeline, and final decision.

nora: I'll review the attestation and post update in ticket #452.

rachel: draft of release notes saved to Drive: https://drive.redwood.com/s/rv_release_notes_draft (internal)

alex: keeping thread open; will close when legal gives final OK or we rollback. :thumbsup:
